Topic 15.2: Reading 15.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 15.2.1 Fluency, part of Caring for others Suggested vocabulary care, listen, special, help, love, sick,  in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we become better readers? 2) How can we express emotions while reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. pick out words with the target letter-sound combinations: ‘st-’ ‘sw- ’,spr-, scr-
2. learners with low vision read words with the letter-sound combinations from either print or digital stories with appropriate font size, colour contrast and light intensity. Learners with blindness read words with the letter-sound combinations from braille or 1)

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 15.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration -developed through group and pair work as learners recite poems for fluency.

Values:
Unity as they work in group/pair work activities

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self-esteem) is developed as learners practise fluency in reading.

Link to other Learning Areas:

All learning areas require that learners read a variety of texts fluently.
